verses.kjv: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God's elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;
verses.modern: From Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ — sent for the faith of God's chosen ones and for the knowledge of the truth that leads to godliness,

verses.kjv: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;
verses.modern: in the hope of eternal life, which God — who cannot lie — promised before the world began,

verses.kjv: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour;
verses.modern: and has now in His own time made known His word through the preaching that was entrusted to me by the command of God our Saviour —

verses.kjv: To Titus, mine own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.
verses.modern: to Titus, my own son in the faith we share: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.

verses.kjv: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee:
verses.modern: The reason I left You in Crete was this: that You should set in order the things that are still lacking, and ordain elders in every city, as I directed You.

verses.kjv: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.
verses.modern: An elder must be blameless — the husband of one wife, with faithful children who are not accused of wild living or rebellion.

verses.kjv: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;
verses.modern: For a bishop must be blameless, as God's steward — not self-willed, not quick-tempered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain,

verses.kjv: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;
verses.modern: but a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, and self-controlled,

verses.kjv: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.
verses.modern: holding firmly to the faithful word as He has been taught, so that He may be able by sound doctrine both to encourage others and to refute those who contradict it.

verses.kjv: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:
verses.modern: For there are many who are unruly — empty talkers and deceivers — especially those of the circumcision.

verses.kjv: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre's sake.
verses.modern: Their mouths must be stopped. They are upsetting whole households, teaching things they ought not to teach — and all for dishonest gain.

verses.kjv: One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, The Cretians are alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.
verses.modern: One of their own, a prophet of theirs, said, "The Cretians are always liars, evil beasts, lazy gluttons."

verses.kjv: This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;
verses.modern: This testimony is true. Therefore rebuke them sharply, so that they may be sound in the faith —

verses.kjv: Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.
verses.modern: not paying attention to Jewish fables or to the commandments of men who turn away from the truth.

verses.kjv: Unto the pure all things are pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.
verses.modern: To the pure, all things are pure; but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure — even their mind and conscience are defiled.

verses.kjv: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.
verses.modern: They claim to know God, but by their works they deny Him. They are detestable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.

chapters.summary: Paul writes to Titus, whom he left in Crete to set things in order and ordain elders in every city. He sets forth the qualifications for elders — blameless, not self-willed, not given to wine, holding fast the faithful word — and warns against false teachers, especially those of the circumcision, who subvert whole houses for dishonest gain.

verses.kjv: But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine:
verses.modern: But as for You, speak the things that are fitting for sound doctrine.

verses.kjv: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.
verses.modern: Teach the older men to be sober, dignified, self-controlled, and sound in faith, in charity, and in patience.

verses.kjv: The aged women likewise, that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;
verses.modern: Teach the older women in the same way — that they be reverent in behavior, not slanderers, not enslaved to much wine, but teachers of good things,

verses.kjv: That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children,
verses.modern: so that they may train the young women to love their husbands and to love their children,

verses.kjv: To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.
verses.modern: to be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, kind, and obedient to their own husbands — so that the word of God is not spoken against.

verses.kjv: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.
verses.modern: In the same way, urge the young men to be sober-minded.

verses.kjv: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,
verses.modern: In all things, show Yourself to be a pattern of good works. In Your teaching show integrity, dignity, and sincerity,

verses.kjv: Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.
verses.modern: with sound speech that cannot be condemned — so that the opponent may be put to shame, having nothing evil to say about You.

verses.kjv: Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters, and to please them well in all things; not answering again;
verses.modern: Urge servants to be obedient to their own masters and to please them well in all things — not talking back,

verses.kjv: Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.
verses.modern: not stealing, but showing all good faithfulness, so that in everything they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour.

verses.kjv: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,
verses.modern: For the grace of God that brings salvation has appeared to all men,

verses.kjv: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;
verses.modern: teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present world,

verses.kjv: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;
verses.modern: looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ —

verses.kjv: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.
verses.modern: who gave Himself for us, that He might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for Himself a peculiar people, zealous for good works.

verses.kjv: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise thee.
verses.modern: Speak these things, exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no one despise you.

chapters.summary: Paul instructs Titus to teach sound doctrine: that aged men be sober, aged women reverent, young women love their husbands, and young men be sober-minded. He declares that the grace of God that brings salvation has appeared to all men, teaching us to deny ungodliness and worldly lusts and to live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present world, looking for the blessed hope and glorious appearing of our great God and Saviour Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,
verses.modern: Remind them to be subject to rulers and authorities, to obey magistrates, to be ready for every good work,

verses.kjv: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.
verses.modern: to speak evil of no one, to be peaceable, to be gentle, and to show all meekness to all men.

verses.kjv: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
verses.modern: For we ourselves were once foolish, disobedient, deceived — slaves to all kinds of lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

verses.kjv: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared,
verses.modern: But when the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared —

verses.kjv: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;
verses.modern: not because of works of righteousness that we had done, but according to His mercy He saved us — by the washing of regeneration and the renewing of the Holy Ghost,

verses.kjv: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour;
verses.modern: whom He poured out on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour,

verses.kjv: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
verses.modern: so that, having been justified by His grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

verses.kjv: This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.
verses.modern: This is a faithful saying. I want You to affirm these things firmly, so that those who have believed in God may be careful to devote themselves to good works. These things are good and profitable for all men.

verses.kjv: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
verses.modern: But avoid foolish controversies, genealogies, arguments, and quarrels about the law — for they are unprofitable and useless.

verses.kjv: A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;
verses.modern: Reject a man who is a heretic after the first and second warning,

verses.kjv: Knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sinneth, being condemned of himself.
verses.modern: knowing that such a person is corrupted and sins, being self-condemned.

verses.kjv: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.
verses.modern: When I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, do your best to come to me at Nicopolis, for I have decided to spend the winter there.

verses.kjv: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.
verses.modern: Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their way with diligence, so that they lack nothing.

verses.kjv: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.
verses.modern: And let our people also learn to devote themselves to good works to meet pressing needs, so that they will not be unfruitful.

verses.kjv: All that are with me salute thee. Greet them that love us in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
verses.modern: All who are with me send You their greetings. Greet those who love us in the faith. Grace be with You all. Amen.

chapters.summary: Paul instructs Titus to remind believers to be subject to authorities, to be gentle, and to be ready for every good work. He declares that God saved us not by works of righteousness but according to His mercy, by the washing of regeneration and renewing of the Holy Ghost, and warns Titus to avoid foolish questions, genealogies, and contentions about the law.
